newsitem.title: ITALY: Italtel, Marconi regroup defence telecoms.
newsitem.headline: Italtel, Marconi regroup defence telecoms.

text.p: Italian telecommunications systems maker Italtel said it was transferring control of its defence telecommunications activities to a new company Marconi Italtel Difesa (MID) set up jointly with Marconi, part of GEC.

Italtel said in a statement it would retain 40 percent of MID and the new company would have share capital of 20 billion lire, more than 150 employees and with a target turnover of 60 billion lire in 1997.
The agreement is part of a restructuring by Italtel and concentration on its core businesses of services and products for civil telecommunications networks.
